name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 12; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 03-regenerate.sh
command:
bash -c TMPD=$(mktemp -d) && echo "TMPD=$TMPD" && python3 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/helpers/e3a_scan.py --stimulus dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json --output "$TMPD/regen.json" && python3 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/helpers/e3a_scan.py --stimulus dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json --output docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/stimulus-issues.json && cmp "$TMPD/regen.json" docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/stimulus-issues.json && echo "BYTE-EQUAL: temp regen == delivered JSON" && python3 - <<PY
import hashlib, json
frozen = json.load(open("dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json"))
recs = {r["research_item_id"]: r for r in frozen["records"]}
inv = json.load(open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/stimulus-issues.json"))
ref_rows = [f for f in inv["findings"] if f["rule_id"] == "R-REF1"]
print("R-REF rows:", len(ref_rows))
assert len(ref_rows) == 6, len(ref_rows)
for f in ref_rows:
    rid = f["research_item_id"]
    tid = f["location"]["turn_ids"][0]
    text = next(t["content"]["text"] for t in recs[rid]["conditions"]["final_prompt_only"]["turns"] if t["turn_id"] == tid)
    want = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
    got = f["location"]["text_sha256"][tid]
    assert got == want, (rid, tid)
    assert "human_decisions_open" in f and set(f["human_decisions_open"]) == {"is_noun_phrase", "has_referent", "needs_context", "risk_ambiguity_relation"}, rid
print("R-REF hashes independently verified from frozen stimulus: 6/6")
print("counts:", inv["meta"]["counts"])
PY

name: 05-diff-check.sh
command:
bash -c git diff --check && echo "diff-check clean"; echo "---WRITE-CHECK---"; git status --short dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json results/dataset_audit/ dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_content_du.py dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_content_ctl.py tests/test_phase7f_stimulus.py; echo "(empty above = stimulus/audit/content/tests untouched)"; echo "---E3A-UNTOUCHED---"; python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok, n = True, 0
for line in open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a/run-outputs.sha256"):
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) != 2: continue
    exp, path = parts
    if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256") or "run-outputs.sh.stdout" in path: continue
    got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    n += 1
    if got != exp:
        ok = False; print("MODIFIED", path)
print(f"E3a {n} files checked")
print("E3A-UNTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY
sha256sum dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json

name: 06-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"

name: 07-run-outputs.sh
command: bash -c sha256sum docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/README.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/stimulus-issues.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/stimulus-issues.json docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/helpers/e3a_scan.py docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/revision-map.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/comparisons.md docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/hashes-start.txt docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/hashes-end.txt docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/delivery.diff docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/logs/01-git-head-status.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/logs/02-env.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/logs/03-regenerate.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/logs/04-targeted-tests.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/logs/05-diff-check.sh.stdout docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/logs/06-link-check.sh.stdout | tee docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/run-outputs.sha256; echo "---SELF (log only, not in file)---"; sha256sum docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/run-outputs.sha256 docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E3a-r1/commands.jsonl
